rider_load.attachment: rigid thorax inertia; spherical rider approximation

limitations: Experimental policy transfer to active legs/wings; upstream flight actuator filtering, 30 ms wing-force ramp and monotonic clearance-dependent leg targets. Launch reference is 1.5 mm; hover commands change smoothly after 250 ms. Attitude is measured against the published 47.5 degree reference pitch, not vertical. Synthetic ghost command; no connectome, neural landing, or biological qualification.

landing.wing_transition: native angle-error torque conversion; measured grip to measured folded wing targets
landing.limitations: Engineering floor descent and leg extension; distinct claw contacts required and non-claw collisions excluded from stable hold. No walking resume or biological landing validation.

walking_resume.claw_release: engineering grip ramp then native policy
